observation.visible_scene: A person's left hand grips the black knob of a transparent glass lid covering a black, white-speckled two-handled pot sitting on a foil-lined stovetop beside a granite counter. Through the steam-fogged glass a white, foamy liquid is visible. The excerpt begins mid-action with the lid already being handled.
visible_changes: Frames 1-3: the hand holds the lid knob fairly steadily on the pot.
Frames 4-9: the hand lifts and translates the lid upward and toward the left, tilting it; motion blur increases as the lid leaves the pot.
Frames 10-12: the lid slides out of view at the left edge, fully exposing the pot's contents.

Frames 13-41: with the lid gone, the open pot is shown; the white liquid continues to simmer, its foam surface undulating and bubbling, with a grainy patch near the center; both pot handles are now visible in frame.
The background (foil, granite counter, stove grates) stays largely in place, with only slight framing drift.
outside_clip_unknowns: The source video's start (how the lid came to be held) and end (whether the lid is replaced or the heat changed) are not in this segment.
The identity of the boiling liquid and the cause of the boil are not shown.
uncertain_details: Whether the change in framing after lid removal is camera motion or simply the un-occluded view of the left handle is not fully determinable.
The exact nature of the surface bubbles (steam vs. boiling foam) cannot be separated from reflections on the glass in early frames.
